purpose: Standalone white-background images for user upload to Meshy

files.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image is a three-panel creature turnaround. Extract and faithfully reproduce ONLY the LEFTMOST FRONT creature as ONE standalone front image intended as an image-to-3D upload. The user needs the actual isolated subject, not a concept-art presentation sheet.
Canvas portrait 1024 x 1536 if possible. Solid pure WHITE (#FFFFFF) background from edge to edge. NO gray gradient, vignette, floor, ground shadow, contact shadow, pedestal, beam, environment, labels, title, text outside the creature, border, inset, second view or diagram. Natural self-shadowing on the creature only. Show the full subject centered, with every fingertip and the eye-crown tip fully inside frame, comfortable white margin about 6 percent at top and bottom. Character fills about 88 percent of height.
Keep precisely the front-facing anatomy, proportions, material colors, vein pattern, layered membranes, hooked hands and pose of the LEFTMOST reference figure. Exactly two massive elongated upper arms lifted above a narrow torso, with five long bent fingers on each giant hand and worn cuff bands. No head at the shoulders. Exactly two small front arms crossed naturally over the lower abdomen above a hanging tapered multi-eye crown. No legs or feet. Six broad layered continuous fleshy membranes, three per side, blue-gray branching veins and pale fleshy borders; small natural holes and scalloped margins. Preserve the open spaces separating fingers, arms and torso. Keep the two shoulder metal rings. Retain only cuff markings that belong physically to the creature; no editorial text.
Rendering is a crisp, realistic, neutral studio asset render with clearly readable volume, pale gray ivory skin, restrained moist satin highlights, gray-blue eyes and weathered metal. No sketch lines, no brushy concept-art treatment, no dramatic lighting, no cinematic colors. Camera exactly orthographic straight FRONT, not a three-quarter view. DO NOT redesign, change pose, turn the eyes into a human face, add appendages, add supporting metal beams, or paste the entire three-view sheet. Deliver exactly ONE full intact creature on plain pure white.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input 1 is the definitive three-view anatomy sheet. Input 2 is the new clean FRONT upload image; match its rendering, palette and exact creature identity.
Produce ONLY ONE standalone true LEFT SIDE PROFILE of this SAME intact creature, facing LEFT, from the CENTER figure of input 1. This file is intended for image-to-3D upload. Do not output a presentation board or multiple views.
Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536 if possible, perfectly plain pure WHITE (#FFFFFF) background all the way to edges, no gray tint/gradient, floor, cast shadow, vignette, text, captions, diagrams, borders, surrounding objects, metal beam or scenery. Creature centered at same vertical scale and pose as input 2, full hooked fingertips and eye-crown tip visible; leave white safety margin. Neutral studio lighting with natural self shadows only, crisp sculptural volume and detailed believable skin. Match front input's pale ivory warm-gray flesh, blue vascular membrane veins, gray-blue iris colors and worn metal cuffs.
Keep SAME hanging pose and SAME proportions as input 2. Exactly two huge bent arms reach upward; in a true side orthographic view the far arm and far hooked hand naturally overlap the near arm and hand. Do not invent more hands or separate the limbs into a new pose. No shoulder-level head. The small crossed pair of arms is on the FRONT of the lower torso, projecting LEFT in this side image. Tapered multi-eye crown hangs below abdomen, large front eyes face LEFT, smaller posterior eyes to RIGHT. No feet or legs. Six continuous layered membranes (three per side), same natural holes, fleshy edges and scallops, originate on posterior shoulder/back and drape behind the small front arms toward image RIGHT. Do not add outer skeletal wing struts, feathers or extra leaves.
Use the center reference SIDE for correct sagittal depth and exact layering, and the clean FRONT input to keep materials and anatomical identity consistent. View exactly 90 degrees from FRONT, orthographic, not three-quarter, no pose change. Remove ALL headings and the two other reference views. Deliver exactly ONE complete isolated creature on white.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input 1 is the definitive three-view anatomy sheet. Input 2 is the new standalone FRONT image for image-to-3D upload and sets the exact identity, proportions, material and lighting.
Output exactly ONE isolated BACK view of the same intact creature, using the RIGHTMOST BACK view in input 1, with the same hanging pose as input 2. This is a standalone asset image for 3D reconstruction, NOT a concept-art sheet.
Portrait 1024 x 1536 if possible. Entire background perfectly flat WHITE (#FFFFFF), no floor, no shadows on background, no gradient, vignette, title, text, labels, border, diagrams, insets, other figures, metal support beam or environment. Full body fully visible from hooked fingertips to eye-crown tip, centered with white margin, same vertical scale as input 2. Crisp realistic neutral studio asset render with natural self-shadowing only, detailed sculptural volume, pale ivory flesh, subtly moist satin surface, blue-gray veins in membranes and weathered wrist cuffs.
True orthographic REAR camera 180 degrees from front. Preserve exactly two huge long bent arms raised overhead and two giant hooked five-finger hands; same hand/cuff and shoulder level as front. No head at shoulder level, no legs or feet. Two dark shoulder metal attachment rings visible from rear.
Show uninterrupted ridged dorsal torso/spine and layered posterior membranes matching the RIGHTMOST BACK reference. The two SMALL abdominal arms are on the FRONT and MUST be hidden behind the torso from this rear view: do NOT show crossed hands, elbows or a second abdomen on the back. The hanging tapered eye-crown rear has smaller embedded eyes and continuous tissue folds, not the arrangement of large front eyes pasted on the rear.
Exactly six broad continuous membrane lobes, three per side, overlapping with the same scalloped edges and natural holes as the front and reference back. Keep physical fleshy border thickness and clear layered volumes, no feathers, no separate strips, no added wings, no extra leaves. The torso, hanging arms, eye-crown length and membrane extents must describe the same creature as input 2. No turn toward camera, no three-quarter perspective, no spread-wing action pose. Deliver one complete rear-facing subject on pure white.
